framework_metadata.description: Blackwell 2-GPU CFG-parallel + cuDNN-SDPA SGLang-Diffusion Cosmos3 T2I profile.
framework_metadata.notes: Measured on 4xB200 2026-09-13, two interleaved rounds. Against the previous `--tp-size 2 --attention-backend fa` command: 0.765 -> 0.576s and 0.797 -> 0.575s, about -25%, taking the cell from losing to vLLM-Omni (0.651-0.662s) to beating it. TWO changes, both measured separately. (1) CFG parallelism instead of TP: the case is guidance_scale 6.0 -- true CFG, two branches -- so one branch per GPU with the DiT replicated and one combine per step beats splitting every layer and paying an all-reduce per layer (0.765 -> 0.584, 0.797 -> 0.617). It is also what sglang's own runtime would choose: cosmos3 inherits auto_enable_cfg_parallel=True with get_auto_cfg_parallel_degree(2)->2 and _model_default_uses_cfg()->True, but `--tp-size 2` made _has_explicit_parallel_policy() true and suppressed it. The sibling Cosmos3 T2V profile already uses CFG parallel; T2I was the odd one out. (2) torch_cudnn_sdpa instead of fa, on top of that: 0.584 -> 0.576 and 0.617 -> 0.575, same sign both rounds, and far steadier -- its repeats spread 0.9% (0.572-0.577) where fa's swung 0.579-0.792. Exact softmax, same precision class as fa, and the backend vLLM-Omni serves this case with. fa2 does not run at all: there is no native transformer for it, so the loader tries a Diffusers fallback and refuses under tp>1. NOTE: at tp_size=1 that refusal no longer guards this cell -- the harness scans the server log for the fallback markers instead. 4xB300 A/B 2026-10-22: 0.576/0.574 s, ahead of the GB300 compile profile (0.603/0.593).

framework_metadata.notes: Blackwell attention choice, measured on this box 2026-09-12. FLASH_ATTN is a Hopper-only precompiled kernel -- vLLM-Omni refuses it on sm_100 with 'FLASH_ATTN was explicitly selected but is unsupported'. FLASHINFER_ATTN starts but dies under torch.compile on dynamic shapes (`AsPythonConstantNotImplementedError: SymNodeVariable() is not a constant` in the FlashInfer backend's _ensure_plan), observed on qwen-image and cosmos3 t2v; it is fine for the static image cases (zimage, flux), which are deliberately left on it. Also drops --stage-configs-path: vLLM-Omni 0.29 rejects it outright (`stage_configs_path is no longer supported; use deploy_config instead`), and upstream's own cosmos3 deploy file says the T2I/video checkpoints must keep the default single-stage diffusion fallback -- so cfg-parallel and guardrails move to the first-class flags rather than to a new YAML. The old YAML also pinned enforce_eager, which silently ran this competitor compile-off against the policy. 2026-10-22: --no-diffusion-compile-dynamic added; cand-dynamic keeps the previous command for the A/B.
